item.title: Mother of Trans Teen Worries About Trump's Medicaid Policy Impact
item.description: A California Republican says the administration's actions against transgender youth are personally affecting her family.

item.title: Mixed Week for Italy's Art Police and Museum Security

item.title: Tommy John, pitcher who inspired landmark elbow surgery, dies at 83
item.description: The MLB left-hander, whose 1974 injury led to a revolutionary surgery, passed away at age 83.
